pairs.subject: transactions-over-a-replicated-log
pairs.evidence: crates/table-ledger/src/audit.rs:310 The ledger writes straight into a local rusqlite IMMEDIATE transaction with no log to propose to. Case-insensitive searches of crates/ and this crate for consensus, applied_index, replicated_log, quorum and modified_since found nothing, and crates/table-ledger/Cargo.toml lists no consensus or log library. That means the subject's precondition, a store whose only writer is a consensus log, does not hold.

pairs.subject: transactions-over-a-replicated-log
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/ListEngine.tsx:149 The console only filters, searches and sorts rows it is handed, in memory, and never commits a transaction to any store. A case-insensitive search of the console directory for consensus, applied_index, replicated_log, quorum and modified_since found nothing, so there is no replicated log here for the subject to govern.
